# XDKs

> Official client libraries for the X API v2 in Python, TypeScript, Java, and C#.

## Packages

- **Python**: `xdk` (`v0.12.0`, Python 3.8+) — `pip install xdk` — [Index](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/llms.txt)
- **TypeScript**: `@xdevplatform/xdk` (`v0.9.0`, Node.js 18+ (ESM & CommonJS)) — `npm install @xdevplatform/xdk` — [Index](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/llms.txt)
- **Java**: `com.x:xdk` (`v0.2.0`, Java 17+) — `implementation("com.x:xdk:0.2.0")` — [Index](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/llms.txt)
- **C#**: `XDevPlatform.Xdk` (`v0.2.0`, .NET 8.0+) — `dotnet add package XDevPlatform.Xdk` — [Index](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/llms.txt)
